bluemap.title: 3D Map (BlueMap)
bluemap.enableHint: Installs BlueMap and exposes an interactive 3D world map in your browser.
bluemap.vanillaUnsupported: Not available on a vanilla server (requires Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt or Paper/Purpur).
bluemap.firewallWarning: TCP port {port} must be open in your firewall / router to access the map externally.
bluemap.renderNotice: Initial rendering can take a long time on a large world. Using BlueMap together with world pre-generation is recommended.
bluemap.recreateRequired: Recreate or restart the server to apply the port mapping and BlueMap mod.
bluemap.enabledToast: BlueMap enabled — restart the server to apply the new port
bluemap.disabledToast: BlueMap disabled — restart the server to close the port
